Burning Hands
1st level evocation

Casting time

1 action

Range

Self (15ft cone)

Components

V,S

Each creature in a 15-foot cone must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 3d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

The fire ignites any flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried.

At higher levels

+1d6 damage for each slot above 1st

Cunning Action
Rogue feature

You can take a bonus action on each of your turns in combat. This action can be used only to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

Fast hands (Thief 3rd)

You can also use the bonus action to make a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check, use your thieves' tools to disarm a trap or open a lock, or take the Use an Object action.

Full Plate
Heavy armor (1500gp)

AC

18

Strength required

15

Stealth

Disadvantage

Heavy

Unless you have the required strength, your speed is reduced by 10 feet.

Stealth

You have disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

Dagger
Simple melee weapon (2gp)

Damage

1d4 piercing

Modifier

Strength or Dexterity

Properties

Light, Finesse, Thrown (20/60)

Finesse

Use your choice of Strength or Dexterity modifier for attack and damage.

Light

When you attack while dual wielding light weapons, you may use a bonus action to attack with your off hand.

Thrown

You can throw the weapon to make a ranged attack with the given range.

Shortsword of Very Long Names
Simple melee weapon (10gp)

Damage

1d6 piercing

Modifier

Strength or Dexterity

Properties

Light, Finesse

Finesse

Use your choice of Strength or Dexterity modifier for attack and damage.

Light

When you attack while dual wielding light weapons, you may use a bonus action to attack with your off hand.

Wand of Magic Missiles
Wondrous item

Maximum charges

7

Recharge

1d6+1 each day

Depletion

If you expend the last charge, roll a d20. On a 1, the item is destroyed.

Spells

You can use your action to cast the following spells:

  • magic missile, 1st level (1 charge)
  • magic missile, 2nd level (2 charges)
  • magic missile, 3rd level (3 charges)
Potion of Healing
Potion (50gp)

Use time

1 action

Hit points restored

2d4+2

When you drink this potion, you regain 2d4+2 hitpoints.

Drinking or administering a potion takes 1 action.

Potion of Healing
Potion (50gp)

Use time

1 action

Hit points restored

2d4+2

When you drink this potion, you regain 2d4+2 hitpoints.

Drinking or administering a potion takes 1 action.

Goblin
Small humanoid (goblinoid)

Armor class

15 (leather armor, shield)

Hit points

7 (2d6)

STR DEX CON INT WIS CHA
8 (-1) 14 (+2) 10 (+0) 10 (+0) 8 (-1) 8 (-1)

Skills

Stealth +6

Challenge

1/4 (50 XP)

Nimble escape

Disengage or Hide as bonus action

Actions

Scimitar

Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage
Dazzling Flash
Uncommon Cleric Evocation Light Visual

Domain

Sun

Cast

material, verbal

Area

15-foot cone

Saving Throw

Fortitude

You raise your religious symbol and create a blinding flash of light. Each creature in the area must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success

The creature is unaffected.

Success

The creature is dazzled for 1 round.

Failure

The creature is blinded for 1 round and dazzled for 1 minute. The creature can spend an Interact action rubbing its eyes to end the blinded condition.

Critical Failure

The creature is blinded for 1 round and dazzled for 1 hour.

Heightened (3rd)

The area increases to a 30-foot cone.

Giant Rat
N Small Animal

Perception

+5; Low-light vision, scent (imprecise) 30 feet

Skills

Acrobatics +5, Atlethics +2 (+4 climb/swim), Stealth +5

Str +1, Dex +3, Con +2, Int -4, Wis +1, Cha -3

AC 15; Fort +6; Ref +7; Will +3

HP 8

Stride

30 feet, Climb 10 feet

Melee

Jaws +7 (agile, finesse). Damage 1d6+1 piercing plus filth fever

Filth Fever

(disease) The sickened and unconscious conditions from filth fever don’t improve on their own until the disease is cured. Saving Throw DC 14 Fortitude.

  • Stage 1: carrier with no ill effect (1d4 hours)
  • Stage 2 sickened 1 (1 day)
  • Stage 3 sickened 1 and slowed 1 (1 day)
  • Stage 4 unconscious (1 day)
  • Stage 5 dead
Manabolt
Direct Spell, Combat
Range Type Duration Drain Damage
LOS P I F-3 P

This spell transforms mana into a focused bolt of energy that you can hurl at a target. The target resists with Willpower. The bolt inflicts Physical damage. The spell can be learned only by magicians and mystic adepts.

Whispers from the Void
Forbidden Knowledge

You gain insight into the terrifying truths of the cosmos, knowledge that can shatter a lesser mind.

Madness

At the start of each day, roll a d20. On a 1, you gain a random madness.

Powers

  • You can cast 'Dissonant Whispers' once per day.
  • You have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.
Gaze of the Abyss
Eldritch Invocation

Prerequisite

15th level, Great Old One patron

You can open your mind to the void, unleashing a torrent of psychic energy.

Action

As an action, you can target one creature you can see within 60 feet. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 8d10 psychic damage and is stunned until the end of your next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half damage and is not stunned.

Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

Unspeakable Vessel
Large aberration

Armor class

17 (natural armor)

Hit points

157 (15d10 + 75)

STR DEX CON INT WIS CHA
20 (+5) 12 (+1) 20 (+5) 18 (+4) 16 (+3) 6 (-2)

Saving Throws

Con +10, Wis +8

Skills

Perception +8

Damage Resistances

psychic

Condition Immunities

charmed, frightened

Senses

truesight 120 ft., passive Perception 18

Languages

understands all languages but can't speak, telepathy 120 ft.

Challenge

10 (5,900 XP)

Actions

Tentacle Slam

Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 15).

Maddening Gaze

The vessel targets one creature it can see within 60 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be affected by the 'confusion' spell for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Blood for the Star-Gods
Rare Ritual Necromancy

Cast

1 hour; Cost 1,000gp of fresh humanoid blood

Secondary Casters

4

Primary Check

Religion (Expert)

Secondary Checks

Occultism

You and the secondary casters conduct a horrific ritual to appease the entities that dwell between the stars.

Critical Success

You gain the favor of a star-god, granting you a powerful boon for 1 month.

Success

You gain a minor boon for 1 week.

Failure

The ritual fails and you attract the attention of a malevolent entity.

Critical Failure

A portal to a horrifying dimension opens, unleashing an unspeakable horror.

Heightened (10th)

The boons are permanent.

Servant of the Outer Gods
CE Medium Humanoid

Perception

+15; darkvision

Languages

Aklo, Common

Skills

Deception +17, Occultism +20, Religion +18, Stealth +15

Str +3, Dex +5, Con +4, Int +6, Wis +7, Cha +5

AC 30; Fort +16; Ref +18; Will +15

HP 150

Stride

25 feet

Melee

Ceremonial Dagger +18 (agile, finesse, magical). Damage 2d4+5 piercing plus 1d6 mental.

Ranged

Eldritch Blast +18 (range 120 feet). Damage 3d10+5 force.

Reaction

Maddening Defense: When targeted by an attack, the servant can force the attacker to make a DC 30 Will save. On a failure, the attacker is frightened 2.

Forbidden Lore

The servant has access to forbidden knowledge, granting it a +2 bonus to all saving throws against divine magic.

  • Stage 1: carrier with no ill effect (1d4 hours)
  • Stage 2 sickened 1 (1 day)
  • Stage 3 sickened 1 and slowed 1 (1 day)
  • Stage 4 unconscious (1 day)
  • Stage 5 dead
Mind Lash
Direct Spell, Combat
Range Type Duration Drain Damage
LOS P I F-2 S

This spell allows the caster to manifest their will as a psychic whip, lashing out at the target's mind. The target resists with Willpower + Firewall. The whip inflicts Stun damage. The spell can be learned by any magic user with a connection to the astral plane.

Gaze of the Abyss
Eldritch Invocation

Prerequisite

15th level, Great Old One patron

You can open your mind to the void, unleashing a torrent of psychic energy.

Action

As an action, you can target one creature you can see within 60 feet. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 8d10 psychic damage and is stunned until the end of your next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half damage and is not stunned.

Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.
